research_interpretation: The opening drive established an in-play stock and 379.28 retest target. A quieter pullback compressed the call's trade premium; a replay of the price logic recognized the curl as PULLBACK_RESUMPTION at 10:52, while the stock volume gate under repository defaults rejected that early pivot. By 10:57 the local volume burst passed in the reconstructed stock path, while the full live option/market decision remains unknown. A candidate improvement is to treat the low-volume pullback as constructive setup context and use renewed option activity and reclaim confirmation for the entry, then evaluate against failed curls without widening all alerts indiscriminately.
